=== PRICING ===
A basic 3-page business website (Home, About, Contact) starts from $300 and takes 1-2 weeks.
A 5-10 page website with custom design starts from $600 and takes 2-4 weeks.
E-commerce websites start from $1000 depending on features.
Custom AI chatbot integration starts from $200.
Mobile apps start from $2000 depending on complexity.
Final price depends on design complexity, features, and integrations. For an exact quote, contact us at info@retnavia.com.

=== TIMELINE ===
Basic websites: 1-2 weeks. Business websites: 2-4 weeks. E-commerce: 4-6 weeks. Mobile apps: 6-12 weeks.
Urgent delivery is possible for an additional fee.

=== PROCESS ===
1. Free consultation call to discuss requirements
2. Proposal with price and timeline
3. 50% advance payment to start
